vampire.text: CLASSIFIED. Agent K-9 reporting. After {confidence} certainty and one very nervous intern, the Bureau confirms: the subject is a VAMPIRE. Evidence on file: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Neighbours describe the subject as charming, punctual after sunset and very into capes. No cause for alarm. Do not invite them in unless snacks are provided.
vampire.action: Offer garlic bread and see what happens.

vampire.text: Case {case_number}. The scanner hissed. The lights flickered. The intern fainted (unrelated). Analysis points to a VAMPIRE, roughly {true_age} years young. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The subject is believed to be friendly, nocturnal and excellent at dramatic entrances.
vampire.action: Close the curtains and compliment their cape.

vampire.text: Bureau memo, top secret. Field readings indicate a VAMPIRE in our midst. We noted {clue_1}. We noted {clue_2}. Frankly, we also noted {clue_3}. Taken together, the scanner is {confidence} sure. The subject appears to prefer sunsets, late-night snacks and staying mysteriously fashionable.
vampire.action: Hand them a tomato juice and act natural.

vampire.text: Agent K-9 here, whispering. Do not make sudden movements. The subject is a VAMPIRE. The giveaway? {clue_1}, plus {clue_2}, plus the small matter of {clue_3}. Bureau historians believe the subject has attended every great party for {true_age} years and left before sunrise every single time.
vampire.action: Offer them the comfiest seat away from the window.

vampire.text: URGENT: the Bureau's bat detector has gone off for the first time since 1987. Subject classification: VAMPIRE. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: mostly theatrical. The subject is expected to say “I vant” at least once tonight.
vampire.action: Ask them to say “I vant to be alone” for the official record.

vampire.text: Dossier {case_number}. The subject has been flagged for elegance beyond the legal limit. Further scans revealed {clue_1} and {clue_2}, and the decisive clue: {clue_3}. Verdict: VAMPIRE, {confidence} certain. The Bureau recommends calm, soft lighting and a polite refusal to lend them your best umbrella.
vampire.action: Invite them to a candlelit board-game night.

vampire.text: The Bureau's resident garlic expert has reviewed the footage. Findings: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, {clue_3}. Conclusion: VAMPIRE. The subject is considered dashing, reliable after dark, and suspiciously good at keeping secrets for {true_age} years.
vampire.action: Give them a glow-in-the-dark name badge.

vampire.text: Transmission begins. Scanner confidence {confidence}. The subject is a VAMPIRE of the friendly variety. They were spotted with {clue_1}. Records also show {clue_2}. Sources further report {clue_3}. Please remain calm and, if possible, fabulous.
vampire.action: Play spooky organ music whenever they enter a room.

alien.text: Agent K-9 reporting from the Bureau's Department of Very Far Away. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. The subject is an ALIEN, most likely here on a polite fact-finding mission. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. The disguise is excellent. Ten out of ten. The mothership would be proud.
alien.action: Ask them, kindly, to take you to their leader.

alien.text: Case {case_number}. Our antennae are tingling. Analysis confirms an ALIEN visitor who has been studying Earth snacks for {true_age} years. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The subject is believed to be friendly and mildly confused by doorbells.
alien.action: Offer them a slice of pizza for scientific comparison.

alien.text: Bureau memo. The scanner picked up a faint signal saying “beep boop, all is well”. Suspicious. Further readings show {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: ALIEN. The subject should be treated as an honoured guest and possibly asked about faster-than-light travel.
alien.action: Point at the sky and ask which star is home.

alien.text: URGENT. The Bureau's satellite dish swivelled on its own. Subject classification: ALIEN, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: adorable. The subject may attempt to blend in by saying “greetings, fellow human”.

Dossier {case_number}. Intercepted message from deep space: “Agent is undercover, do not blow cover.” Oops. The subject is an ALIEN. Evidence logged: {clue_1}, then {clue_2}, then {clue_3}. The Bureau apologises to the subject's home planet for any inconvenience.
alien.action: Hum a sci-fi theme tune and see if they join in.

alien.text: Agent K-9 here. I've seen a lot in this job, but rarely an ALIEN this well disguised. The scanner only cracked it thanks to {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Estimated time on Earth: {true_age} years. Favourite human invention: almost certainly the nap.
alien.action: Show them how a toaster works. Slowly.

alien.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is an ALIEN on a cultural exchange programme. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed, with great excitement: {clue_3}. The Bureau considers them a delightful ambassador for their galaxy.
alien.action: Teach them a dance move to take back home.

alien.text: The Bureau's crop-circle consultant has examined the evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Their professional opinion, after much thoughtful humming, is ALIEN. The subject appears peaceful, curious and very interested in your snacks.
alien.action: Leave a plate of cookies out as a welcome gift.

kaiju.text: Agent K-9 reporting. Seismographs are wobbling. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. The subject is a KAIJU. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Although technically a giant city-stomping lizard, the subject seems kind, considerate and careful around small furniture.
kaiju.action: Clear a path and offer them a very large sandwich.

kaiju.text: Case {case_number}. Coastal sirens are on standby. Analysis confirms a KAIJU, roughly {true_age} years since last emerging from the ocean. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The Bureau notes the subject has never once stepped on a city. Well done.
kaiju.action: Build them a cardboard city to gently stomp.

kaiju.text: URGENT. The scanner screen got very, very dramatic. Subject classification: KAIJU. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: big hugs. Please keep model trains out of reach.
kaiju.action: Practise your best monster-movie scream together.

kaiju.text: Bureau memo. We asked the subject to stand back from the scanner. They did. It didn't help. Readings show {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}, and the verdict is KAIJU at {confidence}. The subject is gentle and only here for the excellent view.
kaiju.action: Organise a small parade in their honour.

kaiju.text: Dossier {case_number}. Local pigeons have relocated. The subject is a KAIJU in an extremely convincing travel-sized disguise. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, {clue_3}. The Bureau commends the subject's pocket-mode technology.
kaiju.action: Ask them to roar on the count of three.

kaiju.text: Agent K-9 here, speaking from a safe distance. The subject is a KAIJU. How do we know? {clue_1}. Also {clue_2}. Also, crucially, {clue_3}. Estimated time asleep under the sea: {true_age} years. Estimated appetite: one entire buffet.
kaiju.action: Order extra snacks. Then order more.

kaiju.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject has been classified KAIJU, protector of the coastline and lover of naps in warm shallow water. Observations: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Please stand clear of the tail.
kaiju.action: Hand them the remote and let them pick the monster movie.

kaiju.text: The Bureau's giant-monster desk has reviewed the case: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: KAIJU. The subject is classified as a friendly titan and an honorary member of the city planning committee.
kaiju.action: Award them a tiny crown for not stomping anything today.

werewolf.text: Agent K-9 reporting. The Bureau's howl detector is going wild. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. The subject is a WEREWOLF. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. By day, a perfectly nice person. By full moon, a perfectly nice person who really wants to chase a frisbee.
werewolf.action: Throw a frisbee and observe carefully.

werewolf.text: Case {case_number}. The moon has been consulted and it nodded. Analysis confirms a WEREWOLF, {true_age} years into an excellent career of moonlit jogging. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. Loyal, energetic and great at parties.
werewolf.action: Offer them a squeaky toy as a sign of friendship.

werewolf.text: Bureau memo. A distant howl was heard just as the scan finished. Coincidence? The readings say no: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: WEREWOLF. The subject is advised to avoid silver cutlery at dinner and to enjoy themselves anyway.
werewolf.action: Swap their fork for a wooden one, just in case.

werewolf.text: URGENT. Every dog in the neighbourhood just sat up. Subject classification: WEREWOLF, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: tail-wagging. The subject may be found doing zoomies after dessert.
werewolf.action: Ask them, very politely, to fetch.

werewolf.text: Dossier {case_number}. The subject's lunar calendar is suspiciously well organised. Further scans show {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: WEREWOLF. The Bureau notes the subject is a great friend and an excellent guardian of the snack table.
werewolf.action: Start a group howl and see who joins in first.

werewolf.text: Agent K-9 here. As a K-9 myself, I respect this. The subject is a WEREWOLF. The clues: {clue_1}. Then {clue_2}. And finally {clue_3}. Estimated time spent howling at the moon: {true_age} years and counting.
werewolf.action: Award them a Good Werewolf certificate, valid at full moon.

werewolf.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is a WEREWOLF of the friendly, campfire-story kind. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed, under a suspicious moon: {clue_3}. Please keep tennis balls out of sight.
werewolf.action: Hide a tennis ball and time how fast it's found.

werewolf.text: The Bureau's moon specialist has reviewed the evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: WEREWOLF. The subject is cleared for all social events, provided someone brings a blanket and a good playlist for howling.
werewolf.action: Put on a song with a big howl in the chorus.

zombie.text: Agent K-9 reporting. The scanner groaned, then the subject groaned, then we all groaned. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. The subject is a ZOMBIE. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. This is a friendly zombie. It mostly wants coffee, a nap and maybe a cheese toastie.
zombie.action: Offer coffee immediately. Do not ask questions.

zombie.text: Case {case_number}. The subject has been shuffling with great dignity. Analysis confirms a ZOMBIE, {true_age} years into an extended lie-in. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The Bureau considers the subject harmless before breakfast and delightful after it.
zombie.action: Make them breakfast. A big one.

zombie.text: URGENT. The scanner requested a snooze. Subject classification: ZOMBIE, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: yawning. The subject may say “braaains” but is believed to mean “brunch”.
zombie.action: Say “brunch?” and watch them perk up.

zombie.text: Bureau memo. The subject is a ZOMBIE, but the cosy kind. Our evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Known habits include hitting snooze, wearing slippers outside and moaning gently at alarm clocks. Relatable.
zombie.action: Hand them a blanket and a warm drink.

zombie.text: Dossier {case_number}. The Bureau's undead division has confirmed a ZOMBIE. Evidence logged: {clue_1}, then {clue_2}, then {clue_3}. Despite being technically undead, the subject is in great spirits and excellent company.
zombie.action: Teach them a dance that involves arms straight out in front.

zombie.text: Agent K-9 here. I gently poked the subject and they mumbled “five more minutes”. Classic ZOMBIE behaviour. Clues: {clue_1}. Then {clue_2}. Then, slowly, {clue_3}. Estimated nap debt: {true_age} years.
zombie.action: Play an upbeat song to reboot their systems.

zombie.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is a ZOMBIE on a quest for the perfect cup of tea. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed, at a leisurely pace: {clue_3}. Please walk, do not run; they are very relaxed about it.
zombie.action: Put the kettle on. Right now.

zombie.text: The Bureau's sleep-science lab has reviewed the evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: ZOMBIE. The subject is cleared for social events after at least one coffee and a short sit-down.
zombie.action: Bring them a coffee with a tiny umbrella in it.

robot.text: Agent K-9 reporting. The scanner detected a faint whirring sound. Confidence: {confidence}. The subject is a ROBOT. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Model number unknown. Warranty: probably expired. Friendliness subroutine: fully operational.
robot.action: Ask them to do the robot dance. For science.

robot.text: Case {case_number}. Beep. Boop. Analysis confirms a ROBOT, assembled roughly {true_age} years ago in a very tidy factory. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The subject is precise, punctual and suspiciously good at maths.
robot.action: Ask them what 17 times 23 is and time the answer.

robot.text: URGENT. The Bureau's Wi-Fi bars went up when the subject arrived. Subject classification: ROBOT, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: helpful. The subject may offer to reorganise your cupboards.
robot.action: Let them reorganise your cupboards. Everyone wins.

robot.text: Bureau memo. Our scanners requested a firmware update just from looking at the subject. Readings: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: ROBOT. The subject runs on good vibes and possibly AA batteries.
robot.action: Offer them a phone charger and see if they accept.

robot.text: Dossier {case_number}. The subject's handshake was precise to the millimetre. Further scans show {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: ROBOT. The Bureau welcomes our efficient new friend and asks that they not take over the world before lunch.
robot.action: Say “beep boop” and wait for a reply.

robot.text: Agent K-9 here. I tried to play fetch with the subject and they calculated the ball's trajectory instead. ROBOT. The clues: {clue_1}. Then {clue_2}. And, conclusively, {clue_3}. Uptime: {true_age} years without a single crash.
robot.action: Give them an oil-can trophy for reliability.

robot.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is a ROBOT with an advanced politeness module. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed, with sensors fully calibrated: {clue_3}. Please do not spill drinks near them.
robot.action: Speak only in a robot voice for the next minute.

robot.text: The Bureau's robotics desk has examined the case: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: ROBOT. The subject is classified as an excellent friend with impressive battery life and zero bugs (that we know of).
robot.action: Challenge them to a game of chess. Prepare to lose.

ghost.text: Agent K-9 reporting. The temperature dropped two degrees and someone said “boo”. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. The subject is a GHOST. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. A very friendly ghost, mostly interested in rattling teacups and starting group sing-alongs.
ghost.action: Turn the lights down and tell a spooky story.

ghost.text: Case {case_number}. The scanner tried to focus and politely gave up. Analysis confirms a GHOST, haunting with style for {true_age} years. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. Known to float through doors and always remember birthdays.
ghost.action: Leave a door open for them. They prefer it.

ghost.text: URGENT. A curtain moved and nobody touched it. Subject classification: GHOST, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: spooky but sweet. The subject may say “oooOOOooo” at random, and that's fine.

Bureau memo. The subject is a GHOST, the classic bedsheet model, chains removed for comfort. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. The subject is a great listener and unbeatable at hide-and-seek.

Dossier {case_number}. Our ectoplasm sensors lit up like a birthday cake. Further scans show {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Verdict: GHOST. The Bureau notes the subject is completely harmless and makes any room feel delightfully mysterious.
ghost.action: Offer them a marshmallow. Ghosts love marshmallows.

ghost.text: Agent K-9 here. My fur stood on end, which only happens near a GHOST. The clues: {clue_1}. Then {clue_2}. And, faintly, {clue_3}. Estimated haunting experience: {true_age} years. Favourite hobby: appearing in the background of group photos.
ghost.action: Take a group photo and check the background.

ghost.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is a GHOST with impeccable manners. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed, very quietly: {clue_3}. Please speak softly; they startle easily, which is ironic.
ghost.action: Dim the lights and announce “we come in peace”.

ghost.text: The Bureau's paranormal desk has examined the case: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: GHOST. The subject is cleared for all social events and is particularly welcome at sleepovers and campfires.
ghost.action: Hand them a torch for dramatic campfire storytelling.

human.text: Agent K-9 reporting. Scanner confidence: {confidence}. After extensive analysis, the subject is CERTIFIED HUMAN… for now. Evidence: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. The Bureau is, frankly, a little disappointed, but will keep the file open just in case.
human.action: Keep watch during the next full moon.

human.text: Case {case_number}. The scanner beeped once, sadly. Analysis indicates a regular HUMAN. Exhibit A: {clue_1}. Exhibit B: {clue_2}. Exhibit C: {clue_3}. The subject is cleared for normal activities, such as paying bills and eating salad.
human.action: Rescan after midnight. Just to be sure.

human.text: Bureau memo. No capes, no antennae, no ectoplasm. The subject appears to be a HUMAN. Readings: {clue_1}, {clue_2} and {clue_3}. Our monster-detection budget is now under review.
human.action: Lend them a disguise so they fit in at the next monster party.

human.text: URGENT (not really). Subject classification: CERTIFIED HUMAN, {confidence} certain. Supporting evidence: {clue_1}; {clue_2}; {clue_3}. Threat level: none. Excitement level: also none. The Bureau suspects a very, very good disguise.
human.action: Ask for a second opinion. Monsters are sneaky.

human.text: Dossier {case_number}. Our scanners searched high and low. The subject is a HUMAN, or the best-disguised monster in Bureau history. Evidence logged: {clue_1}, then {clue_2}, then {clue_3}. File status: open, slightly suspicious.
human.action: Put on a cape and try again.

human.text: Agent K-9 here. I sniffed around thoroughly and found only HUMAN. The clues: {clue_1}. Then {clue_2}. Then {clue_3}. The Bureau congratulates the subject on being refreshingly ordinary, which is its own kind of rare.
human.action: Give them a Certified Human sticker. They earned it.

human.text: Transmission begins. Confidence {confidence}. The subject is a HUMAN. Observed: {clue_1}. Observed: {clue_2}. Observed: {clue_3}. Nothing spooky, nothing alien, nothing that howls. The agent on duty has gone back to their crossword.
human.action: Celebrate with a perfectly normal sandwich.

human.text: The Bureau's review board has examined the case: {clue_1}, {clue_2}, and {clue_3}. Verdict: CERTIFIED HUMAN… for now. The subject may continue living their delightfully ordinary life, under very light surveillance.
human.action: Wave at the camera. The Bureau is watching. Kindly.
